Marta: Heads-up — AcmeCloud marketplace deal stalled. Procurement won't issue PO until vendor profile shows Redwood as billing entity and net-60 invoice terms. Marketplace portal shows reseller (CloudResell LLC) as payee. Customer procurement insists on direct billing. Can Legal/Finance expedite?

Raj: This is for the enterprise AcmeCorp APAC order? They're on enterprise contract but asked for Marketplace flow to keep quoting simple.

Marta: Correct. Sales rep flagged it this morning — buyer said their AP team can't accept reseller invoices.

Elaine: I'll check the contract redlines. Quick Q: did we sign a marketplace reseller agreement with CloudResell that assigns billing? If so, we might need an addendum to allow direct invoicing.

Kevin: Finance — we can issue direct invoices, but marketplace reconciliation requires onboarding in the cloud portal with bank details. Who's the marketplace account owner? @Sam?

Sam: Marketplace account is registered under CloudResell's marketplace ID `cr-4987`. If we flip billing to Redwood, we need vendor verification + tax docs. Portal ETA for verification is usually 5-7 biz days unless expedited. I can open a ticket with Partner Ops.

Marta: Customer can't wait 7 days — their go-live window is EOD Fri. Any workaround? Net-60 is fine for us.

Nina: Could we accept a short-term workaround: CloudResell issues the PO, but we put an MSA addendum stipulating net-60 and Redwood as ultimate payee, then we reconcile internally? Not ideal but buys time.

Elaine: Legal cautious. We can draft a one-page addendum authorizing pass-through billing but it requires counterparty acceptance and signature. Need exact marketplace seller ID and the customer's PO template to scope it.

Raj: I'll push buyer to accept interim 'pro-forma' invoice so they can meet procurement compliance and pay via CloudResell; then we reconcile.

Sam: Opening portal escalation ticket now — raising a 'billing entity change' with cloud marketplace ops and marking priority: high. Ticket #MP-71234. ETA 48 hours at best.

Marta: Share the ticket link / escalation contact pls.

Sam: Ticket link: https://marketplace.cloud/vendor/MP-71234 (internal). I'm also DM'ing our marketplace partner rep Sheila to ask for expedited verification.

Elaine: Uploading draft addendum here: ```
Addendum (draft): Seller agrees to accept pass-through invoicing for PO ACME-7789 and acknowledges net-60 payment terms. Counterparty to sign within 24 hours.
```

Raj: PO from Acme attached (sent by buyer). PO# ACME-7789. They require 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' as payee and net 60 days.

Marta: Thanks. I'll coordinate with customer and keep them posted. If anyone can help fast-track verification (legal/finance contacts at CloudResell or marketplace rep), ping me.

marketplace-bot: Reminder — changing seller/billing entity may trigger revenue recognition hold. Contact RevOps for impact.

Kevin: Noted — RevOps, please standby. If we accept pass-through temporarily, we need to track deferred revenue flags and tax implications.

Nina: Also flag Solutions: if licensing SKU mapping changes between seller accounts, we may need a mapping table to avoid duplicate entitlements or broken seat allocations.

Marta: Appreciate it. I'll do check-ins every 2 hours today. TL;DR: procurement blocked by billing entity mismatch; Sam opened MP ticket #MP-71234; Legal drafting addendum; Finance/RevOps standing by.
